sources.name: Brampton Library
sources.notes: Communico/libnet feed, same pattern as Hamilton/Kingston libraries - confirmed live 2026-08-26 with real JSON (e.g. 'Movers and Shakers' toddler program). Also carries the annual 'Newcomer Day' community event when scheduled. Age field distinguishes children's programming from adult.

sources.name: Downtown Brampton BIA
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress/tribe) confirmed live 2026-08-26 - JSON events[] with downtown programming (e.g. 'Seasonal Delights'). Covers Garden Square / Rose Theatre concerts, markets, and festivals in the downtown core.

sources.name: Sheridan College - International Student Events
sources.notes: Checked 2026-10-20: the international events page loads from Sheridan's Sitecore search API; the same API behind sheridancollege.ca/events is now read directly (open houses incl. Davis/Brampton, info sessions, student webinars). The international-only page is mostly overseas recruiter visits, so the general events feed is the useful one.

sources.name: Newcomer Centre of Peel (NCP)
sources.notes: Checked 2026-10-20: ncpeel.ca has no events system at all (WordPress pages/posts only - no calendar plugin, no Eventbrite links, no event post type), so there is nothing to crawl. Kept as a hand-entry source: add dated NCP events (orientations, job fairs) here as manual events when announced.

sources.name: Peel Newcomer Strategy Group (PNSG)
sources.notes: Checked 2026-10-20: peelnewcomer.org has no events system (WordPress/Divi pages + 'project' posts only); its PD sessions are for settlement-sector staff, not students. Kept as a hand-entry source for Peel Newcomer Day and partner events when dates are announced.

sources.name: City of Brampton Festivals & Events
sources.notes: Checked 2026-10-20: brampton.ca's events calendar says it is being rebuilt and its event pages render dates with JavaScript (often last year's), so they can't be crawled reliably. Kept as a hand-entry source for the City's big free festivals (Diwali Mela, Winter Lights, New Year's Eve, Canada Day) once dates are confirmed.

sources.name: Hope Reformed Church - Free ESL Classes
sources.notes: Standing weekly free ESL classes (Thursdays 7:00-8:30pm at 375 Clark Blvd, Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced, new topic weekly) explicitly for newcomers - contact ESL@hopereformedchurch.ca. wp-json/tribe route 404s 2026-08-26 - no feed, term-based standing program only. Left with an empty manual event list per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.name: Brampton Santa Claus Parade
sources.notes: Added 2026-10-19 from the must-do events sweep: 'Brampton Santa Claus Parade' (Nov) was missing from this city's board. Annual/one-off festival organizer - hand-enter real dates as manual_events once announced; never invent dates.

sources.name: The Rose Brampton
sources.notes: Checked 2026-10-20: therosebrampton.ca blocks crawlers, but its box office (tickets.brampton.ca, AudienceView) lists every Rose, Cyril Clark, Lester B. Pearson and Garden Square performance with date, time, venue and price - now read directly. Paid shows are capped like other ticketed feeds; free 'This is Brampton' nights score normally.

sources.name: Achēv - newcomer workshops (Brampton + online)
sources.notes: Added 2026-10-20. Large GTA settlement agency with a Newcomer Information Centre in Brampton; ~10 free events a day (job search, resume, citizenship, orientation, hiring events, community kitchen). Region-wide feed, so venue_filter keeps only Brampton venues and online sessions.

sources.name: PAMA - Peel Art Gallery Museum + Archives
sources.notes: Added 2026-10-20. Downtown Brampton museum/gallery: workshops, film screenings, folk nights, holiday drop-ins. Event list is on PAMA's iMIS site (dates only, no times or prices on the list).

sources.name: Bramalea Baptist Church
sources.notes: Added 2026-10-20. 9050 Dixie Rd, Brampton; hosted an International Students Dinner on 2023-09-14. SnapPages site, no feed - hand-enter when the next dinner is announced.
